Subject: Vendor registration and ledger mapping for Redwood Inference

Hi Elaine / NimblePay AP team,

We're starting vendor registration with NimblePay so Redwood can be listed as a supplier in your AP system (to receive POs from Acme Retail and other customers routed through your platform). Quick context: Redwood Inference (Redwood.ai) provides hosted and private LLM inference services; we'll be sending monthly invoices tied to customer POs.

Can you confirm the full vendor packet you need? Specifically we want to make sure we provide:
- Legal entity name, DBA and company registration number
- VAT / tax certificate (EU) or W-9 equivalent (US)
- Primary remit bank details + beneficiary name and IBAN/SWIFT
- Remittance ID / invoice reference format so PO matching works
- GL code mapping file (we can provide a suggested mapping to your product/service codes)
- Any test/sandbox endpoint for e-invoice submissions (XML/EDI)

Also, do you enforce PO header semantics (e.g. must include 'Reference' field or a specific tag for our Redwood invoice number)? We've seen customers reject invoices when the remittance ID doesn't map.

I'll loop in Finance (laura@redwood.ai) and Product Ops (grace@redwood.ai) to gather attachments. Appreciate any portal link and a checklist so we can send a single packet.

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Head of Partnerships (acting)
Redwood Inference

Hi Alex,

Thanks — happy to get Redwood onboarded. We've created a supplier ticket and attached the standard vendor packet. High level requirements below:

1) Portal registration: https://portal.nimblepay.com/supplier-onboard/ABCD-1234 (use the token in the packet).
2) Required documents (PDFs):
   - Company incorporation + legal name
   - VAT certificate or W-9 / W-8 BEN for tax residency
   - Bank wiring matrix (IBAN + SWIFT + beneficiary)
   - Primary AP contact and remittance email
3) Invoice/PO mapping rules:
   - PO must include a 'RemitReference' field (max 35 chars) that aligns to your invoice number; we use that for 2‑way match.
   - For EDI/e-invoice submissions send sample XML that includes <RemitReference> and <GLAccount> tags.
4) GL mapping: We accept a CSV with your suggested GL mapping; our onboarding team will map product SKUs to our buyer GLs.
5) VAT & Self-billing:
   - EU buyers may require reverse charge; if the buyer elects self-billing we need an agreement signed (we can host).
   - For US customers, include tax classification (W-9).

Attachments: nimblepay_vendor_packet.pdf (contains portal steps, privacy and ACH/EFT setup guide). Please upload the completed packet in the portal.

Once you upload, I'll route to our Onboarding Ops. We also offer a sandbox e-invoice endpoint for testing (details in the packet).

Regards,
Elaine Cho
Supplier Onboarding Lead
NimblePay Inc.
elaine.cho@nimblepay.com

Thanks for the packet. Please find answers and the requested artifacts attached. Summary of key fields you asked for:

- Legal entity: Redwood Inference, Inc. (DBA Redwood.ai)
- Tax docs: redwood_vat_certificate.pdf attached for EU; we will provide W-9 for US customers in the portal as well.
- Bank remit: see redwood_bank_wiring_matrix.xlsx (includes beneficiary, IBAN, SWIFT, bank address).

- For buyers in the EU that request reverse charge, Redwood will issue invoices net of VAT and include the buyer's VAT ID where requested. We are not offering blanket self-billing authority; we can sign a per-buyer self-billing agreement if the buyer requests it and provides documentation.
